edit.statement: 'Is a colleague of' and 'is married to' are disjoint: no two people can be both colleagues and spouses.
edit.subject: colleague_of
edit.original: 'Is a colleague of' and 'is married to' may overlap: spouses can also be colleagues.
edit.scope: Pairs of people; only the disjointness of the two relations is added.
